name: Badlands Reagent Run
summary: In the outpost of Kargath, Jarkal Mossmeld, an alchemist of some note, needs reagents found out in the Badlands to replenish stocks. Coin is promised, but only to someone who brings the goods.

sections.title: Stocking the Shelves
sections.body: Jarkal Mossmeld is short on ingredients: gizzards from five buzzards, fangs from ten crag coyotes, and shards from five rock elementals. All three can be taken from the creatures themselves. Anyone who is not the fighting type is told to find friends who are. Jarkal pays in coin, but only once the reagents are in hand.

sections.title: After the Haul
sections.body: Pleased with the haul, Jarkal says it should last a little while. The alchemist has more reagents to gather, but these can be found only far down inside the Uldaman excavation and will not be easy to get. Jarkal hints that the pay may be worth more than shiny coins.

faq.q: Who is asking for these reagents?
faq.answer: Jarkal Mossmeld, an alchemist of some note at the outpost of Kargath in the Badlands, who wants to replenish the stocks.
Gizzards from five buzzards, fangs from ten crag coyotes and shards from five rock elementals. All of them come from the creatures themselves.

aliases: where to turn in badlands reagent run
faq.answer: Jarkal is in the outpost of Kargath, in the Badlands.

faq.q: What does Jarkal offer in exchange for the ingredients?
faq.answer: Coin, paid once the reagents are brought to Jarkal in Kargath. Nothing is paid before then.
